column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “heeds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “integrity of way” is rendered “him whose way is blameless.”
Close to the Hebrew; גְּעָרָה (“a threat, rebuke”) is rendered “rebuke.”
Close to the Hebrew; מֵהֶבֶל (“from vapor”) is rendered “gained by dishonesty,” and “by hand” “by labor.”
Close to the Hebrew; יֵחָבֶל לוֹ (“be in debt to it”) is rendered “will be destroyed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the instruction (torah)” is rendered “The law.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֵיתָן (“is perennial / harsh”) is rendered “is hard.”
Close to the Hebrew; “there is what is swept away for lack of justice” is rendered “for lack of justice there is waste.”
Close to the Hebrew; “seeks him early with discipline” is rendered “disciplines him promptly.”
